title: tc-json-viewer
description:
A JSON document laid out for review – Document, Tree and Raw views, search across them, flags with notes on fields,
Copy and Download – inline or as a modal.

heading.description: The heading, and the viewer's name

description.description: One line under the heading; by default the document's size and how many values it holds

value.description: The document, already parsed. `source` is used when this is undefined

source.description: The document as JSON text, parsed when `value` isn't given; a syntax error is shown where it is

view.description: The view shown. Changed by the user unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

filter.description: What the search box holds. Changed by the user unless tc-filter-change is prevented

flags.description: The reviewer's flags. Changed by the user unless tc-flags-change is prevented

keyStyle.description: How Document names fields: "words" ("Invoice date") or "raw" (the key as written)

expandDepth.description: How many levels the tree shows open at first

filename.description: The name Download saves the file under

locale.description: The language for numbers and dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

modal.description: Show it as a dialog, opened by `open`

open.description: With `modal`: whether the dialog is showing. Escape and Close ask to close (tc-open-change)

JsonFlag.description: A reviewer's flag: the field (a JSON Pointer) and what they said about it
